boundary: Synthetic signatures and fixtures are not independent hackathon participant accounts.
The burst demonstrates bounded intake integrity and durable recovery, not a production latency or deadline capacity guarantee.
Two local Worker isolates verify shared-D1 lease fencing, not deployed autoscaling or regional resilience.
Docker/container argument and bridge tests do not prove live container capacity.
Storage and scanner outages are controlled injections, not production provider failures.
